animations.label: Enable Animations
animations.description: Toggle window animations. Gesture transitions still animate when this is off.

layer_animations.label: Layer Animations
layer_animations.description: Animate layer-shell surfaces such as panels and notifications. Requires animations.

animation_type_open.label: Open Animation Type
animation_type_open.description: Open animation for windows. Unset uses slide; none disables it.

animation_type_close.label: Close Animation Type
animation_type_close.description: Close animation for windows. Unset uses zoom; none disables it.

layer_animation_type_open.label: Layer Open Animation Type
layer_animation_type_open.description: Open animation for layer surfaces. Unset only fades; none disables it.

layer_animation_type_close.label: Layer Close Animation Type
layer_animation_type_close.description: Close animation for layer surfaces. Unset only fades; none disables it.

animation_fade_in.label: Fade In
animation_fade_in.description: Fade windows in when they appear.

animation_fade_out.label: Fade Out
animation_fade_out.description: Fade windows out when they close.

animation_duration_move.label: Move Duration
animation_duration_move.description: Duration of window move/resize animations in milliseconds (0-50000).

animation_duration_open.label: Open Duration
animation_duration_open.description: Duration of window open animations in milliseconds (0-50000).

animation_duration_tag.label: Tag Switch Duration
animation_duration_tag.description: Duration of tag-switch animations in milliseconds (0-50000).

animation_duration_close.label: Close Duration
animation_duration_close.description: Duration of window close animations in milliseconds (0-50000).

animation_duration_focus.label: Focus Duration
animation_duration_focus.description: Opacity transition duration when focus changes, in milliseconds (0-50000).

animation_curve_move.label: Move Curve
animation_curve_move.description: Cubic bezier curve for move/resize animations (x1,y1,x2,y2).

animation_curve_open.label: Open Curve
animation_curve_open.description: Cubic bezier curve for window open animations (x1,y1,x2,y2).

animation_curve_tag.label: Tag Switch Curve
animation_curve_tag.description: Cubic bezier curve for tag-switch animations (x1,y1,x2,y2).

animation_curve_close.label: Close Curve
animation_curve_close.description: Cubic bezier curve for window close animations (x1,y1,x2,y2).

animation_curve_focus.label: Focus Curve
animation_curve_focus.description: Bezier curve for the focus opacity transition (x1,y1,x2,y2).

animation_curve_opacity_fade_in.label: Fade In Curve
animation_curve_opacity_fade_in.description: Cubic bezier curve for fade-in opacity animations (x1,y1,x2,y2).

animation_curve_opacity_fade_out.label: Fade Out Curve
animation_curve_opacity_fade_out.description: Cubic bezier curve for fade-out opacity animations (x1,y1,x2,y2).

scroller_structs.label: Scroller Side Margin
scroller_structs.description: Pixels reserved on each side of the scroller area (0-1000).

scroller_default_proportion.label: Default Proportion
scroller_default_proportion.description: Default width proportion for new windows in the scroller layout.

scroller_default_proportion_single.label: Single Window Proportion
scroller_default_proportion_single.description: Width proportion for a tag with one window. Requires scroller_ignore_proportion_single=0.

scroller_ignore_proportion_single.label: Ignore Single-Window Proportion
scroller_ignore_proportion_single.description: Ignore scroller_default_proportion_single when the tag has one window.

scroller_focus_center.label: Scroller Focus Center
scroller_focus_center.description: Always center the focused window in the scroller viewport.

scroller_prefer_center.label: Scroller Prefer Center
scroller_prefer_center.description: Center the focused window only when it was outside the viewport.

scroller_prefer_overspread.label: Prefer Overspread
scroller_prefer_overspread.description: Focused edge window fills unused space. Overrides scroller_focus_center and scroller_prefer_center.

edge_scroller_pointer_focus.label: Edge Pointer Focus
edge_scroller_pointer_focus.description: Focus scroller windows that are partly off-screen.

edge_scroller_focus_allow_speed.label: Edge Focus Speed
edge_scroller_focus_allow_speed.description: Minimum pointer speed required before edge focus triggers (0-1000).

focus_cross_monitor.label: Cross-Monitor Focus
focus_cross_monitor.description: Let directional focus cross monitor boundaries.

focus_direction_only_zone_overlap.label: Focus Direction Zone Overlap
focus_direction_only_zone_overlap.description: Directional focus only picks windows overlapping the current window on the perpendicular axis.

exchange_cross_monitor.label: Cross-Monitor Exchange
exchange_cross_monitor.description: Let exchange_client and move_client cross monitor boundaries.

scratchpad_cross_monitor.label: Scratchpad Cross Monitor
scratchpad_cross_monitor.description: Share the scratchpad pool across all monitors.

focus_cross_tag.label: Cross-Tag Focus
focus_cross_tag.description: Let directional focus cross tag boundaries.

view_current_to_back.label: View Current to Back
view_current_to_back.description: Viewing the current tag switches to the previously viewed tag.

blur_layer.label: Blur Layer Surfaces
blur_layer.description: Apply blur to layer-shell surfaces (panels, notifications). Requires blur.

blur_optimized.label: Optimized Blur
blur_optimized.description: Cache the wallpaper and background for faster blur.

blur_params_radius.label: Blur Radius
blur_params_radius.description: Pixel radius of the blur kernel.

blur_params_noise.label: Blur Noise
blur_params_noise.description: Noise level added to the blur.

blur_params_brightness.label: Blur Brightness
blur_params_brightness.description: Brightness multiplier for the blurred layer.

blur_params_contrast.label: Blur Contrast
blur_params_contrast.description: Contrast multiplier for the blurred layer.

blur_params_saturation.label: Blur Saturation
blur_params_saturation.description: Saturation multiplier for the blurred layer. Mango clamps the effective value to 0-1.

shadow_only_floating.label: Floating Shadows Only
shadow_only_floating.description: Only draw shadows for floating windows.

layer_shadows.label: Layer Shadows
layer_shadows.description: Draw shadows under layer-shell surfaces. Requires shadows.

shadows_size.label: Shadow Size
shadows_size.description: How far the shadow extends beyond window edges.

shadows_blur.label: Shadow Softness
shadows_blur.description: Gaussian blur sigma for softer shadows.

single_scratchpad.label: Single Scratchpad
single_scratchpad.description: Show only one scratchpad window (named or standard) at a time.

xwayland_persistence.label: XWayland Persistence
xwayland_persistence.description: Keep XWayland running even when no X11 clients are active.

xwayland_ignore_scale.label: Ignore XWayland Scale
xwayland_ignore_scale.description: Make XWayland use physical pixels instead of the output scale.

sync_obj_enable.label: Sync Objects
sync_obj_enable.description: Use DRM sync object timelines. Requires a restart.

tag_carousel.label: Tag Carousel
tag_carousel.description: Tags wrap around in a carousel.

allow_tearing.label: Allow Tearing
allow_tearing.description: Tearing policy: 0 off, 1 any window, 2 fullscreen only.

hdr_depth.label: HDR Render Depth
hdr_depth.description: HDR render depth: 0 auto, 1 force 8-bit, 2 force 10-bit.

disable_middle_paste.label: Disable Middle Paste
disable_middle_paste.description: Disable middle-click paste by turning off primary selection for Wayland apps.

auto_reload_config.label: Auto Reload Config
auto_reload_config.description: Reload when the main config or a sourced file changes.

no_border_when_single.label: No Border When Single
no_border_when_single.description: Remove borders when only one window is visible.

no_radius_when_single.label: No Corner Radius When Single
no_radius_when_single.description: Remove corner radius when only one window is visible.

monocle_no_radius.label: Monocle No Radius
monocle_no_radius.description: Remove corner radius in monocle layout.

snap_distance.label: Snap Distance
snap_distance.description: Maximum snap distance in pixels for floating windows (0-99999).

enable_floating_snap.label: Floating Snap
enable_floating_snap.description: Snap floating windows to screen edges and other visible floating windows.

float_full_to_top.label: Shared Top Layer
float_full_to_top.description: One layer for fullscreen, floating, and layer-shell top windows. The last raised window is on top.

drag_tile_small.label: Small Tile Preview
drag_tile_small.description: Shrink dragged tile to a small thumbnail.

swipe_min_threshold.label: Swipe Minimum Threshold
swipe_min_threshold.description: Minimum distance in pixels to trigger a swipe gesture (1-1000).

gesture_live.label: Live Gestures
gesture_live.description: Update tag, focus, and overview transitions while fingers move, not only after release.

gesture_swipe_distance.label: Swipe Distance
gesture_swipe_distance.description: Finger travel (px) that corresponds to one full page transition.

gesture_swipe_cancel_ratio.label: Swipe Cancel Ratio
gesture_swipe_cancel_ratio.description: Fraction of the last page to drag before release commits the swipe.

gesture_swipe_min_speed_to_force.label: Swipe Force Speed
gesture_swipe_min_speed_to_force.description: Average speed per event (px) that commits the swipe below the cancel ratio.

focused_opacity.label: Focused Opacity
focused_opacity.description: Opacity of the currently focused window.

xkb_rules_layout.label: XKB Layout
xkb_rules_layout.description: Keyboard layout codes, for example 'us' or 'us,ru'.

scroller_proportion_preset.label: Proportion Presets
scroller_proportion_preset.description: Preset width proportions (0.1-1.0) cycled by switch_proportion_preset.

new_is_master.label: New Windows as Master
new_is_master.description: New windows open in the master area instead of the stack.

default_master_factor.label: Master Area Factor
default_master_factor.description: Master area size: width in horizontal layouts, height in vertical layouts (0.1-0.9).

default_master_count.label: Number of Masters
default_master_count.description: Number of windows in the master area.

tag_gather.label: Gather Tags
tag_gather.description: Compact occupied tags to consecutive numbers starting at 1. The current view follows.

center_master_overspread.label: Center Master Overspread
center_master_overspread.description: In center_tile, let the master area fill the screen when there are no stack windows.

center_when_single_stack.label: Center Master With One Stack Window
center_when_single_stack.description: Center the master when the stack has only one window.

dwindle_vertical_split.label: Vertical Split
dwindle_vertical_split.description: Where a new window goes in a vertical split: 0 follows the cursor, 1 below, 2 above.

dwindle_horizontal_split.label: Horizontal Split
dwindle_horizontal_split.description: Where a new window goes in a horizontal split: 0 follows the cursor, 1 right, 2 left.

dwindle_preserve_split.label: Dwindle Preserve Split
dwindle_preserve_split.description: Keep the sibling split geometry when a window closes.

dwindle_smart_split.label: Dwindle Smart Split
dwindle_smart_split.description: Choose the split direction from the cursor position inside the focused window.

dwindle_smart_resize.label: Smart Resize
dwindle_smart_resize.description: When dragging a split, move it toward the cursor regardless of which side was grabbed.

dwindle_drop_simple_split.label: Dwindle Drop Simple Split
dwindle_drop_simple_split.description: Use a 2-zone drop preview that follows dwindle_split_ratio instead of four quadrants.

dwindle_manual_split.label: Manual Split
dwindle_manual_split.description: Use the direction set by dwindle_toggle_split_direction for new splits.

dwindle_split_ratio.label: Split Ratio
dwindle_split_ratio.description: Proportion of space for the first child when splitting.

hotarea_size.label: Hotarea Size
hotarea_size.description: Size of the corner activation zone in pixels (1-1000).

hotarea_corner.label: Hotarea Corner
hotarea_corner.description: Screen corner for the overview hotarea: 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right.

enable_hotarea.label: Enable Hotarea
enable_hotarea.description: Activate overview by moving the cursor to a screen corner.

hotarea_disable_on_fullscreen.label: Hotarea Disable On Fullscreen
hotarea_disable_on_fullscreen.description: Do not trigger the hot area while a fullscreen window is focused.

overcircle_center_ratio.label: Overcircle Center Ratio
overcircle_center_ratio.description: Focused window width as a fraction of usable screen width (0.1-0.9).

jump_labels.label: Jump Label Characters
jump_labels.description: Characters used to label windows in jump label mode, in order.

cursor_hide_timeout.label: Cursor Hide Timeout
cursor_hide_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before auto-hiding the cursor (0 = never).

cursor_hide_on_keypress.label: Hide Cursor on Keypress
cursor_hide_on_keypress.description: Auto-hide the cursor whenever any keyboard key is pressed.

axis_bind_apply_timeout.label: Axis Bind Apply Timeout
axis_bind_apply_timeout.description: Minimum milliseconds between axis binding calls (0-1000). Closer scroll events are ignored.

focus_on_activate.label: Focus on Activate
focus_on_activate.description: Focus windows immediately when they request activation.

idle_inhibit_ignore_visible.label: Allow Hidden Clients to Inhibit Idle
idle_inhibit_ignore_visible.description: Let clients that are not visible inhibit idle.

idle_inhibit_when_fullscreen.label: Inhibit Idle When Fullscreen
idle_inhibit_when_fullscreen.description: Keep idle inhibited while a fullscreen window is focused.

warp_cursor.label: Warp Cursor
warp_cursor.description: Warp the pointer to the center of the focused window when focus changes by keybinding.

drag_corner.label: Resize Corner
drag_corner.description: Floating window resize corner: 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right, 4 nearest.

drag_warp_cursor.label: Warp Cursor on Drag Resize
drag_warp_cursor.description: Warp the pointer to the chosen corner when a resize starts from the window body.

enable_border_resize.label: Enable Border Resize
enable_border_resize.description: Drag a window border with the left mouse button to resize. Tiled windows show only shared edges.

border_resize_size.label: Border Resize Hitbox
border_resize_size.description: Thickness in pixels of the resize grab strip. 0 uses the border width.

smart_gaps.label: Smart Gaps
smart_gaps.description: Disable gaps when only one tiling window is visible.

monocle_tab_mode.label: Monocle Tab Mode
monocle_tab_mode.description: Merge stacked windows into tabs in monocle layout.

monocle_right_button_close.label: Right Click to Close
monocle_right_button_close.description: Right click on the tab bar closes that window.

deck_tab_mode.label: Deck Tab Mode
deck_tab_mode.description: Merge the deck layout's stack windows into a tab.

repeat_rate.label: Repeat Rate
repeat_rate.description: Keyboard repeat rate in key presses per second.

repeat_delay.label: Repeat Delay
repeat_delay.description: Delay before key repeat starts, in milliseconds.

touch_enable_mouse_emulation.label: Touch Mouse Emulation
touch_enable_mouse_emulation.description: Emulate left-button clicks and drags on surfaces that do not accept touch.

tap_and_drag.label: Tap and Drag
tap_and_drag.description: Tap and hold to drag items.

drag_lock.label: Drag Lock
drag_lock.description: Keep dragging after lifting the finger.

cursor_theme.label: Cursor Theme
cursor_theme.description: XCursor theme name. Empty uses the system XCursor theme.

group_bar_decorate_font_desc.description: Pango font description for the group bar.

title_message_bar_decorate_corner_radius.description: Corner radius of the title message bar in pixels.

title_message_bar_decorate_padding_y.label: Title Bar Vertical Padding

tab_bar_decorate_font_desc.description: Pango font description for the tab bar.

tab_bar_decorate_focus_fg_color.description: Text color of the focused tab bar entry.

fields.label: HDR Max Luminance
fields.description: Mastering display peak luminance, also sent as max_cll, cd/m² (0 = unset).

fields.label: HDR Max Average Luminance
fields.description: Max frame-average light level (max_fall), cd/m² (0 = unset).

fields.label: Force HDR
fields.description: Skip the EDID BT.2020/PQ checks when hdr is on. HDR requires the wl-only Vulkan build.

fields.label: ICC Profile
fields.description: Path to an ICC profile. Ignored when HDR is on.

fields.label: Disable
fields.description: Disable the monitor.

fields.label: Primary
fields.description: Make this monitor the X11 (RandR) primary output for XWayland.

fields.label: Custom Mode
fields.description: Custom display mode. Also requires width, height, and refresh. May cause a black screen.

tag_rule.label: Tag Rules
tag_rule.description: Per-tag layout and options. All matching rules apply in order. Later rules override earlier.

fields.label: Tag ID
fields.description: Tag id to match; 0 targets the special tag (tag 0). Use * for all tags.

fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Layout to apply to this tag.

fields.label: Monitor Name
fields.description: Monitor name regex to match.

fields.label: Monitor Make
fields.description: Match by monitor manufacturer.

fields.label: Monitor Model
fields.description: Match by monitor model.

fields.label: Monitor Serial
fields.description: Match by monitor serial number.

fields.label: No Render Border
fields.description: Do not draw window borders on this tag.

fields.label: Open as Floating
fields.description: Open new windows floating on this tag.

fields.label: No Hide
fields.description: Keep the tag advertised to ext-workspace clients when it is empty.

fields.label: Master Count
fields.description: Number of master windows.

fields.label: Master Factor
fields.description: Master area share of the layout (0.1-0.9).

fields.label: Scroller Proportion
fields.description: Default width proportion for new windows (0-1; 0 keeps the global value).

fields.label: Scroller Proportion (Single)
fields.description: Scroller proportion for a single window (0-1; 0 keeps the global value). Used when scroller_ignore_proportion_single is off.

fields.label: Ignore Single Proportion
fields.description: Use the normal scroller proportion when only one window is open.

layer_rule.label: Layer Rules
layer_rule.description: Configure layer-shell surfaces such as bars, launchers, and notifications.

fields.label: Layer Name
fields.description: Layer surface name. Supports regex.

fields.label: Open Animation
fields.description: Layer surface open animation. Empty inherits the global setting. `none` disables it.

fields.label: Close Animation
fields.description: Layer surface close animation. Empty inherits the global setting. `none` disables it.

fields.label: Shield When Captured
fields.description: Black out this layer while a screen capture is active; pair with no_animation:1.

fields.label: No Blur
fields.description: Disable blur for this layer.

fields.label: No Animation
fields.description: Disable layer animations.

fields.label: No Shadow
fields.description: Disable the layer shadow.

window_rule.label: Window Rules
window_rule.description: Set window properties on open. app_id and title are regex. When both are set, both must match.

fields.label: Floating
fields.description: Force floating state.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Match by window title, supports regex.

fields.label: App ID
fields.description: Match by application ID, supports regex.

fields.label: Open Animation
fields.description: Window open animation. Empty inherits the global setting. `none` disables it.

fields.label: Close Animation
fields.description: Window close animation. Empty inherits the global setting. `none` disables it.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Assign to one tag, several tags separated by |, or the special tag with 0.

fields.label: Monitor
fields.description: Assign to monitor by monitor spec (name, make, model, or serial).

fields.label: X Offset
fields.description: Horizontal offset from center in percent. 100 sits at the outer gap.

fields.label: Y Offset
fields.description: Vertical offset from center in percent. 100 sits at the outer gap.

fields.label: No Focus
fields.description: Never give this window keyboard focus.

fields.label: No Fade In
fields.description: Window ignores fade-in animation.

fields.label: No Fade Out
fields.description: Window ignores fade-out animation.

fields.label: No Force Center
fields.description: Do not center the window automatically.

fields.label: Width
fields.description: Floating width: 0 to 1 is a fraction of the usable screen width. Above 1 is pixels.

fields.label: Height
fields.description: Floating height: 0 to 1 is a fraction of the usable screen height. Above 1 is pixels.

fields.label: No Border
fields.description: Remove window border.

fields.label: No Shadow
fields.description: Disable the window shadow.

fields.label: No Radius
fields.description: Disable corner radius.

fields.label: No Animation
fields.description: Disable window animations.

fields.label: Open Unfocused
fields.description: Open without focus.

fields.label: No Focus on Hidden Tag
fields.description: Do not focus the window when it opens on a tag that is not currently visible.

fields.label: Named Scratchpad
fields.description: Mark the window as a named scratchpad toggled by toggle_named_scratchpad.

fields.label: Unmanaged Global
fields.description: Open as unmanaged global window (for desktop pets or camera windows).

fields.label: Global
fields.description: Open as global window (sticky across tags).

fields.label: Scroller Proportion (Single)
fields.description: Width proportion used while this window is the only tiled window (0-1; 0 keeps the global value).

fields.label: Unfocused Opacity
fields.description: Opacity for inactive windows. 0 keeps the global opacity.

fields.label: Focused Opacity
fields.description: Opacity for the active window. 0 keeps the global opacity.

fields.label: Overlay
fields.description: Keep the window in the top layer.

fields.label: Shield When Captured
fields.description: Fill the window with black while a screen capture is active.

fields.label: Allow Shortcuts Inhibit
fields.description: Let this window's client inhibit compositor shortcuts.

fields.label: Ignore Maximize
fields.description: Ignore maximize requests from the client.

fields.label: Ignore Minimize
fields.description: Ignore minimize requests from the client.

fields.label: No Size Hint
fields.description: Ignore the client's minimum and maximum size hints when resizing.

fields.label: Inhibit Idle When Focused
fields.description: Keep idle inhibit active while this window is focused.

fields.label: VRR Only Fullscreen
fields.description: Turn on VRR only while this window is fullscreen. Requires vrr off in its monitor rule.

fields.label: Force Render
fields.description: Keep sending frame callbacks while the window is hidden.

fields.label: Activation Bypass
fields.description: Treat activation requests for this window as authenticated.

fields.label: Terminal
fields.description: Mark the window as a terminal that a newly opened window replaces.

fields.label: Allow CSD
fields.description: Let clients draw their own window decorations.

fields.label: Force Fake Maximize
fields.description: Report the window as maximized to the client while keeping the tiled geometry.

fields.label: Force Tiled State
fields.description: Report floating windows as tiled (on by default).

fields.label: Force Tearing
fields.description: Tearing override: 0 unset, 1 enabled, 2 disabled. Enabled still requires global allow_tearing.

fields.label: No Swallow
fields.description: Do not let this window replace an is_term window.

fields.label: Confine Pointer
fields.description: Keep the pointer inside this window while it is focused and visible.

fields.label: No Blur
fields.description: Disable blur for this window.

fields.label: Scroller Proportion
fields.description: Width proportion for this window in the scroller layout (0-1; 0 keeps the global value).

fields.label: Fullscreen
fields.description: Force fullscreen state.

fields.label: Fake Fullscreen
fields.description: Tell the client it is fullscreen while keeping its tiled size.

fields.label: Global Key Binding
fields.description: Global keybinding as MODS-KEY, for example ctrl+alt-o. Wayland apps only.

device_rule.label: Device Rules
device_rule.description: Device overrides by name or type. kb_* and repeat_* give a keyboard its own keymap and repeat rate.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Match by input device name or vendor:product:name.

fields.label: Device Type
fields.description: Device type to match. touchpad is a deprecated alias for trackpad.

fields.label: Repeat Rate
fields.description: Key repeat rate per second.

fields.label: Repeat Delay
fields.description: Delay before a held key repeats (ms).

fields.label: Keyboard Rules
fields.description: XKB rules file for this keyboard.

fields.label: Keyboard Model
fields.description: XKB model for this keyboard.

fields.label: Keyboard Layout
fields.description: Keyboard layout code, e.g. us or ru.

fields.label: Keyboard Variant
fields.description: Keyboard layout variant, e.g. dvorak or colemak.

fields.label: Keyboard Options
fields.description: XKB options, e.g. caps:escape.

fields.label: Natural Scrolling
fields.description: Invert scrolling direction for this device.

fields.label: Acceleration Profile
fields.description: Pointer acceleration profile: 0 none, 1 flat, 2 adaptive.

fields.label: Acceleration Speed
fields.description: Pointer speed from -1.0 to 1.0.

fields.label: Left Handed
fields.description: Swap left and right buttons.

fields.label: Middle Button Emulation
fields.description: Emulate the middle button.

fields.label: Scroll Method
fields.description: Scroll method: 0 disabled, 1 two-finger, 2 edge, 4 button.

fields.label: Scroll Button
fields.description: Button code for button scrolling. 0 disables it.

fields.label: Click Method
fields.description: Click method: 0 no emulation, 1 button areas, 2 clickfinger.

fields.label: Send Events Mode
fields.description: Send events: 0 on, 1 off, 2 off when an external pointer is present.

fields.label: Tap to Click
fields.description: Tap to trigger a left click.

fields.label: Tap and Drag
fields.description: Tap and hold to drag items.

fields.label: Drag Lock
fields.description: Lock dragging after tapping.

fields.label: Button Map
fields.description: Tap mapping: 0 left/right/middle, 1 left/middle/right.

fields.label: Disable While Typing
fields.description: Disable the trackpad while typing.

fields.label: Monitor
fields.description: Pin touch or tablet input to one output. Unset touch follows focus. Unset tablet stays unmapped.

fields.label: Map to Focused Monitor
fields.description: Make the tablet follow the currently focused monitor.

exec.description: Commands run at startup and on each reload.
